admission_levels.level_1_verifier_only_no_patch: command/verifier evidence without patch; auxiliary verifier/stop/state-update support only
admission_levels.level_3_single_step_closed_loop: state_before + candidate actions + chosen action + command/tool observation + verifier result + state_update + stop/continue
admission_levels.level_4_multi_step_maintainer_episode: two or more causal decision states with evidence updates, patch/verifier transitions, terminal decision

claim_boundary: This stage controls data expansion; current rollup remains train-support only and does not prove unbounded software task completion.
hard_exclusions: ModuleNotFoundError / ImportError / missing dependency as current-state failure
offline missing crate/package as current-state failure
bounded classifier rows treated as closed-loop episodes
cross-source patch/verifier joins without same-root lineage proof

next_subagent_work_packets.goal: increase FAIL_CURRENT_STATE/FAIL_TO_FAIL with real source/test failures, excluding env failures
next_subagent_work_packets.output: candidate list only; main agent materializes deterministic rows
required_evidence: why source/test failure not environment failure

next_subagent_work_packets.goal: find patch/diff records with same-root verifier logs to reach level_2/level_3+ episode supply
next_subagent_work_packets.output: classify as level_2, possible_level_3_if_joined, or blocked_cross_source
required_evidence: state_before/state_after source or what is missing

next_subagent_work_packets.goal: rank local roots likely to produce PASS/FAIL verifier observations without network/install work
next_subagent_work_packets.output: ranked queue for a separate guarded execution stage

training_authorization: no training authorized by this control stage
